channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: LIVE: Trump says Iran deal ‘largely negotiated’; Pakistan says talks soon
item.description: US president makes announcement after mediator Pakistan holds 'highly productive' talks in Tehran.

item.title: Iranian sources lay out Iran-US deal details
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Ali Hashem reveals details of Iran's position on the potential peace agreement with the US.

item.title: Funerals for medics killed in Israeli air strikes in southern Lebanon
item.description: Funerals were held for paramedics killed by two Israeli air strikes in southern Lebanon on Friday.

item.title: Trump says Iran agreement ‘largely negotiated’, awaiting finalisation
item.description: US president says deal would include reopening Strait of Hormuz after call with Middle East leaders.

item.title: Iran move World Cup base from US to Mexico with FIFA approval
item.description: Iran were expected to fly from Turkiye to Arizona to continue World Cup 2026 preparations but will switch to Mexico.

item.title: Pakistan army chief visits Tehran to push for end to US-Israeli war on Iran
item.description: Munir met senior Iranian officials on Saturday as Islamabad and Doha push to finalise a memorandum to end the war.

item.title: ‘United States of the Middle East?’: Trump posts US flag covering Iran
item.description: Latest Truth Social post comes amid 'delicate diplomacy', expert says, as US and Iran indicate progress in talks.

item.title: Suspect killed after opening fire on Secret Service near White House
item.description: Officials say a suspect approached a checkpoint near the building and opened fire, and that a bystander was wounded.

item.title: Rosenberg: Luhansk strike sparks Russian accusations and vow to retaliate
item.description: Eighteen people were killed and 42 others injured in the strike on the town in Russian-occupied eastern Ukraine.

item.title: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
item.description: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.
